question: What claim of uniqueness is being made such that no knowledge equal to this one will exist again in the future?
premises: There is knowledge equal to this.
Such knowledge will not exist again.
Such knowledge will not exist at all in the future sense stated.
inference: The knowledge in question is presented as unique, with nothing equal to it to arise again.
uncertainties: The referent of 'this' is not recoverable from this verse alone.
plain_english: There is no knowledge equal to this; it will not be again, it will not be.
